messages.subject: Problem of loading of methylKit
parts:
Hi,

I have a problem about the install of methylKit. I cannot use biocLite("methylKit") to install this packages, even after I tried several method to install it. There is still a problem about the loading packages. It report an error that: S4Vectors should >= 0.13.13, while mine is 0.10.0. I tried to update S4Vectors, but it still cannot work. 

Could anyone give me advise to solve this problem?

Thanks,
Garen
